title: Enhanced geothermal notches another win as Google buys 400 MW from Fervo | TechCrunch
summary: Geothermal energy company Fervo notched another win as Google agreed to buy nearly half a gigawatt of electricity to power a planned new data center in Utah. Fervo and Google’s new deal adds to the pair’s long-standing relationship.
